mg_blooddraw.client.title: Blood sampling · antecubital fossa
mg_blooddraw.client.too_flat: Too flat: the needle slid off
mg_blooddraw.hint.palpate: Hold the left mouse button on the arm and find the vein.
mg_blooddraw.hint.puncture: Mouse wheel: needle angle (15-30°). Click on the vein.
mg_blooddraw.hint.tourniquet: Press T: tourniquet on (it should not stay on longer than 1 minute).
mg_blooddraw.hint.tubes: Click the next tube in the rack, hold SPACE and release it at the mark.
